{{Top|leg}}
'''Centrality Intelligence''' was a branch of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] government responsible for collecting and providing security intelligence. The agency's primary function was to collect information about [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] governments, corporations and individuals using covert operations and paramilitary actions. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], Centrality Intelligence recruited university professor and [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] ''[[Ottdefa/Legends|Ottdefa]]'' [[Osuno Whett/Legends|Osuno Whett]] as an undercover agent, believing his scholarly background provided him an ideal cover. His handlers assigned Whett to spy on [[Scrivinir]] [[Rokur Gepta]], which ultimately led to his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the [[ThonBoka]] nebula in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].<ref name="thonboka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref>
